question: Which of the following is an artificial ecosystem that is manmade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Crop field.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **artificial ecosystem** is a** man-made ecosystem **that is created by humans for various purposes.
 
• A **crop field** is an example of an artificial ecosystem because it is **created by humans** for the purpose of growing crops.
 
• Crop fields are referred to as artificial ecosystems due to the** manipulation** of various **biotic and abiotic **elements.
 
• Farmers make use of the connection between **producers and abiotic variables.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A natural ecosystem is a **free-living community** of both living and non-living things found in the wild.
 
• All of the components work together as a** single entity** through **chemical, biological, and physical** processes.
 
• A** lake, forest, and pond** are** natural ecosystems **that are not man-made.
 
• A lake is a **large body **of water that is surrounded by land.
 
 
• It is formed** naturally.**
 
 
 
• A forest is a large area that is covered with **trees and other vegetation**. 
 
• A pond is a** small body of water** that is formed naturally and is** not** created by humans.
